text: Darek Voss served as a Sentinel operative (Vanguard variant) under Sentinel High Command within the galactic_union faction.
Operation Silent Dagger: employed shockwave weapons in the rear-guard; KILLED IN ACTION aboard Blackreach Station — the operation's single recorded fatality.
Member of the Silent Dagger team under Commander Aric Thal. Shares a surname with Kael Voss; relationship NOT established — do not infer kinship.
Sentinel-Class Power Suit, Vanguard variant (heavy weapons/shockwave).
